data.about:
PROFILE SUMMARY - Risk & Compliance Analyst with experience in BFSI, specializing in
regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and governance frameworks. Skilled in identifying
control gaps, supporting audits, and implementing risk mitigation strategies. Currently
building expertise in Data Privacy, IT Compliance, and Information Security frameworks.
KEY SKILLS - Risk Assessment & Mitigation
Regulatory Compliance (RBI, SEBI – Basics)
Data Privacy (DPDP Act, GDPR – Basics)
IT Compliance & Controls (Access, Audit, Governance)
Fraud Risk Management
Audit Support & Documentation
Stakeholder Management
EXPERIENCE - Risk & Compliance Analyst
Wipro (Client: Leading Private Sector Bank)
Conducted enterprise-level risk assessments and identified control gaps
Ensured compliance with regulatory frameworks and internal policies
Supported audit activities (internal/external) and compliance reporting
Assisted in implementation of data governance and control mechanisms
Identified risks related to data handling, fraud, and operational processes
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve compliance posture
EDUCATION - Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Mumbai University, 2018
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - Data Privacy & IT Compliance (Self-Learning Initiative)
Studied DPDP Act (India) and GDPR basics
Understood DPIA and PII handling
Explored ISO 27001 and IT control frameworks

subComponents.caption: Jan 2023 - Present · 3 yrs

description.text:
In my role, I developed and implemented a robust information security framework for the financial services sector. I conduct threat intelligence analysis, providing insights for cyber defense. Leading incident response efforts, I ensure swift containment and mitigation, achieving a 30% reduction in incident resolution time.

Ensuring regulatory compliance, I conduct internal assessments, facilitating external audits for financial regulations and cybersecurity standards. My commitment to transparency is evident in effective security governance structures.

I design and execute targeted security awareness programs, resulting in a 25% increase in employee adherence to protocols. Orchestrating cross-sector collaborations, I enhance the industry's ability to respond to and mitigate cyber threats.

Evaluating emerging cybersecurity technologies, I recommend and implement tools, contributing to evolving security architecture. Implementing a cybersecurity framework led to a 20% improvement in our overall security posture within the first year.

I foster collaboration with stakeholders to share threat intelligence, enhancing overall cyber resilience. This extends to cross-functional teams, where I facilitate communication between security and IT teams for effective integration.

Mentoring security professionals, I ensure the team is aware of the latest threats. Leading vulnerability assessment, I collaborate to promptly address vulnerabilities.

In summary, I developed comprehensive security policies, ensuring compliance and continuous improvement. My contributions align with industry best practices, ensuring a proactive stance against evolving cybersecurity challenges.

- Performed comprehensive IT audits, ensuring 100% compliance with regulatory standards. 

- Identified control weaknesses and recommended improvements, enhancing internal controls. 

- Coordinated with departments to address audit findings, resulting in improved risk management. 

- Environment: Apache Tomcat, JBoss EAP, IBM WebSphere, Apache HTTP Server, Oracle HTTP Server, JBoss Fuse, Apache Karaf. 

- Role: WebSphere MQ/AS, JBoss EAP/AS/Fuse, IIS, OHS, IHS, Tomcat, Nginx, and WebLogic (L4 for all specified middleware products).

subComponents.caption: Jan 2023 - Present · 3 yrs

description.text:
Conducted comprehensive risk assessments, identified and mitigated potential fraud and compliance risks within corporate banking operations. Developed and implemented risk mitigation strategies, minimizing exposure.
Ensured adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies. Conducted regular audits and reviews, maintained compliance with banking regulations and standards.
Utilized advanced analytics and monitoring tools, detected and prevented fraudulent activities. Investigated suspicious transactions and collaborated with law enforcement agencies when necessary.
Developed and maintained governance frameworks, ensured effective risk management practices. Provided guidance and training to staff on compliance and risk management protocols.
Prepared detailed reports on risk assessments, compliance audits, and fraud investigations. Maintained accurate and up-to-date documentation of all risk management activities.
Worked closely with internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, regulatory bodies, and auditors, ensuring effective risk management and compliance practices.

Executed ITGC and cybersecurity control testing across banking systems. Conducted risk assessments across 400+ IT assets. Supported audit remediation, governance reporting, and control validation. Prepared RCMs, workpapers, compliance evidence, and assessment reports.
